bandReport.notes: 24 questions, Q74-Q97 contiguous with no gaps. Booklet pages 25-A, 27-A, 29-A, 31-A, 33-A (each PNG is one odd-numbered booklet page). BOTH BAND EDGES VERIFIED FROM THE NEIGHBOURING PAGES RATHER THAN ASSUMED: p11 (B2's last page) ends with Q73 complete — its (d) Deflation sits above the footer with nothing spilling — and my p12 opens with Q74 at the head of the left column and Q76 at the head of the right, both complete; p17 (B4's first page) opens with Q98 at the head of the left column and Q100 at the head of the right, so Q97 on my p16 is the last question of my band and its option block ends inside the right column above the footer. NO shared Directions/code block anywhere in this band — every question carries its own four printed options; the only multi-question stimulus structures are the Q90 Match List and the Q97 pairs table, both self-contained. Question distribution: Q74-80 Economics/Current-Affairs (budget, PLFS, trade, schemes), Q81-85 computer fundamentals, Q86-97 an unbroken Geography block (oceanography, coordinates, geomorphology, climatology). Page defect: Q83's options (b) 10010 and (d) 11001 are 5-bit strings on a stem that specifies a 4-bit computer — verified at 9x, transcribed as printed.
